notes.title: Driving Has Just Become Better
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279094/2f836766f0dee1ed9466f96b39268ca773fc584d.png[/img]

Hello,

today's update (Version 0.6.3.4) brings you the vehicle dashboard, shown to you when entering a vehicle. The instrument panel displays 3 analogue components, the speedometer, the RPM gauge and a fuel gauge.

With it also comes a fuel economy in the game. Driving is no longer for free! (And it wasn't even back then in the 80's - unlike many people want to tell you :) Each vehicle is configured with a different fuel tank capacity and fuel consumption. If you run low on gas, don't forget to fuel up at the gas station or bring some fuel canisters with you.

Watch the depiction under the fuel gauge which tells you which side the tank lid is on. Park in the vicinity of a gas pump and select the action by right-clicking on the vehicle (you have to be outside of the vehicle and close to the fuel pump). If you happen to find a fuel canister, stand besides the fuel pump and select the action "Fill" from the context menu of the fuel canister. When you bring the canister close to the tank lid of a car you can "Add Gas" from the canister to the car.

When entering a vehicle ("E" key) the vehicle no longer starts the engine automatically. You can either just start driving ("W,S") or hit the "SPACE" key to start-up the car. The headlights can also now be switched on and off using the "L" key.

Two new Option (Simulation) properties allow you to configure the initial fuel when a vehicle spawns and the overall fuel consumption rate.

Let me know if you would like to have a rear-view mirror added to the dashboard. I think this might be a nice feature, being able to see what is going on behind the car (a zombie approaching...?).

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Vehicles of other players could display more than 2 light sources
[*] Vehicles could under certain circumstance be driven faster than the speed limit set in Options
[*] Map rendering could fall behind when driving a fast vehicle
[*] Wooden bridge on Map 0,0 (x:600,y:200) had errors
[/list]

Cheers,
Ben

notes.title: New map extension
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279094/8bb7d2dbb0f0b46f80dd65e8fe9613823cace7b7.png[/img]

Version 0.6.3.0 features a map twice as big as the previous one. The map size has grown from one square kilometer to two. If you travel on the main road towards the east you will enter the new map part. You will notice that the landscape also has been modulated in a slightly different way and that it is populated by some new plant types and features depending on the height of the terrain.

The original map part (where the players start) has also been overhauled. This is just the first extension of many more to come, remember that I'm planning to grow the map up to a size of 10 by 10 kilometers.

These are other noteworty features and bugfixes of this release:

Features:
[list]
[*] A second map section has been added to the game, featuring an extensive road, a dirt road and one POI for now
[*] New cactus plants populate the desert. Harvest a cactus for a new (and relatively deadly but not very durable) weapon
[*] Roads have just become safer due to the placement of road deliniators
[*] The Vehicle camera is now connected more like a "rubber band" to the vehicle so that you won't experience vertigo trauma while driving :)
[*] The height resolution of the map has doubled. When digging you will by default change the height of the terrain bei 25 cm (0,25 m). But if you press the Shift-key you will change the terrain height by just 12,5 cm (0.125 m). This for example allows to smooth out roads so that smaller vehicles can properly drive on them without getting stuck.  When driving offroad remember to better choose the Pickup Truck which has a much higher ground clearance ...
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Ambient Occlusion caused flickering on Tree Canopy Materials
[*] Container loot spawn wasn't fully random right from the start of a new campaign
[/list]

What's next? The next release will feature a vehicle dashboard and the need to fuel up your vehicle.

Cheers,
Ben

notes.title: Let There Be Light (and darkness for that matter)
notes.content:
Hello,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279094/d9eb04d3b48e69011c74cf8a336b7a699a4228a5.png[/img]

Another minor update brings a couple of new and improved features.

[list]
[*] Better day and night cycle with hours of "complete" darkness and those during which the moon provides some ambient light
[*] Introduction of a flash light (an essential tool if you dare to walk outside during the night)
[*] Vehicles now also have headlights
[*] Streetlights in urban areas, spotlights in some houses (crafteable)
[*] A new POI (gas station in the South East of the map)
[*] Ambient Occlusion effect which gives the whole map a gloomier look (can be disabled in the Options)
[/list]

Next on the list will be more POIs and the first extension of our map (currently 1 square kilometer). I'm planning to double the map size in the near future but don't expect too many new POIs at the beginning. Those will be added one by one until Modding finally arrives and let's you fill-in some blank spots in the map.

Cheers,
Ben

notes.title: Maintenance release 0.6.2.5
notes.content:
Hi there,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279094/faf6e5445e342b992434e125d0b8b012ee5c15d3.png[/img]

today I have pubished a smaller maintenance release (Version 0.6.2.5) after the major multiplayer update last week.

New Features:

- The console becomes more colorful and will display player commands in blue, error message in red and everything else in a drab grey :) You also can now fetch previous commands with the up arrow key in oder to correct typos etc.
- You can now switch to god mode via (F5 or any other key you have configured via Options->Input) and while in god mode make yourself invisible to zombies (F6 by default)
- The new and larger (and therefore also more efficient in terms of weight reduction) backpack has arrived. Look out for zombies carrying one (see screenshot above)

Bug Fixes:

- When a player character dies the watch, compass and map icons (if in possession of one of those items) were not properly removed from the player UI
- When a player loses a map item (drops it or otherwise) while having two ore more maps in the inventory, the map icon in the upper right corner also disappeared
- Various fixes to zombie pathfinding logic (with respect to garage doors, supermarket checkouts, cars)

Ben

notes.title: Multiplayer mode in the making
notes.content:
Hi there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279094/3b8bd2b885edf19a72d87d8d74512e225f28fba1.png[/img]

Development of multiplayer mode has begun. It'll be rolled out in three phases:

[list]
[*] First, the single player mode will run under the hood in "host" mode - but no one will be able to join yet
[*] As a second step one player will be able to host his/her local game and friends can join in
[*] The third phase consists of providing a dedicated server (most likely Linux in the beginning) that will allow you to host a persistent world
[/list]

Doing the refactoring of the code base like this gives me the chance of testing the core aspects of multiplayer while still technically running a single-player game as a first step.

Then with the second and most crucial phase the Network code will be activated and Sandbox Apocalypse can be experienced in Multiplayer for the first time. My plan is to be able to let a player seamlessly switch Multiplayer on and off and by this either playing on his/her own in the world or sharing it with other people.

When developing the dedicated server I will primarily focus on performance and server/world management.

There is no fixed timetable for the 3 phases but I'm already in the midst of phase-one-development.

All that being said, content and world updates will go along with these releases.

Ben

notes.title: Fiona has arrived
notes.content:
Hello,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279094/c8695e0e9d2991e632d71b1f9a39c75ece6e621e.png[/img]

The first Update of Sandbox Apocalypse brings a couple of improvements, notably the addition of "Fiona" (internal codename for the female character). When starting a new campaign you can now choose between the female or the male version of your hero. Fiona also introduces new clothing (dresses in different colors).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279094/e6ae32091c114154113c77cecf866b31e3cc7944.png[/img]

This also means that Zombies will either have a male or female phenotype and sound slightly different accordingly.

Other changes in this update:
[list]
[*] - A new small POI in the mountains
[*] - A bunch of new Steam Achievements
[/list]

Ben
